question: How do knowers of the āgamas characterize the unification described previously?
premises: The preceding ritual act is being identified.
It is characterized as the joining of channels.
This characterization is attributed to knowers of the āgamas.
inference: Knowers of the āgamas declare this act to be the joining of channels.
plain_english: This is declared by the knowers of the āgamas to be the joining of the channels.
